attr.title: PocketPlex
attr.desc: A lightweight, text-first Plex client for retro handhelds. Browses your own Plex Media Server over Wi-Fi and plays video/music via server-side transcode.
attr.desc_md:
## Notes

- PMS Settings → Network → **Secure connections = Preferred** (not Required), otherwise plain-HTTP LAN calls fail.
- The binary links dynamically against the device's SDL2/cURL; no bundled libs are shipped.
- The gamepad is read natively via evdev; gptokeyb is not used.
attr.inst: Copy `pocketplex/` next to this script into `/userdata/roms/ports/` (it is already so when installed via PortMaster). Set your server/token in `/userdata/roms/ports/pocketplex/conf/pocketplex.ini` (see the example file).
